findings_qualitative.value: Disk PAs in Taurus, Upper Sco, Ophiuchus and ONC are consistent with random orientation.

evidence.quote: The disks located in the star-forming regions, except the Lupus clouds, do not show any signature of the alignment, supporting the random orientation.

findings_qualitative.value: Different PA estimators including sparse modeling agree without significant bias.

evidence.quote: there is no significant bias in the estimated PA among different analysis methods and datasets

claims.hypothesis: Disk axes are aligned within star-forming regions
claims.experiment: Kuiper test of PA distributions in five regions
claims.result: Only Lupus III gives p=0.037; others p>0.16
claims.finding: Mostly random orientation, consistent with turbulent origin; Lupus III is marginal

evidence.quote: The absence of the significant alignment of the disk orientation is consistent with the turbulent origin of the disk angular momentum.

claims.hypothesis: Lupus III PAs are robust against estimator choice
claims.experiment: CLEAN+imfit, uvmodelfit, sparse modeling, other datasets and literature

evidence.quote: there is no significant bias in the estimated PA among different analysis methods and datasets, although there are relatively large scatters

claims.hypothesis: Lupus III alignment is related to filament and magnetic field
claims.experiment: Compare mean PA with filament and Planck field direction
claims.result: Disks parallel to filament, ~perpendicular to field

evidence.quote: This may be suggestive, but not conclusive at this point.

why_this_method.value: Kuiper test handles rotational invariance unlike KS test

evidence.quote: a widely-used statistics to validate the non-uniformity of the distribution, the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for instance, cannot be applied in a straightforward fashion.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: ALMA ONC data rejected because of spurious elongation giving artificial 6 sigma alignment; HST used instead

evidence.quote: our preliminary analysis suggested an *artificial* alignment of the disks even at a 6$\sigma$ level.

limitations_admitted.value: Statistically limited sample; Lupus III result marginal

evidence.quote: Our current result is statistically limited, so future analyses or observations of other disk systems are highly desired.
